 High Court Of Chhattisgarh, Bilaspur

 Naveen Kumar T. and others Versus State of Chhattisgarh and another

sentences.text: Mr. Himanshu Sharma, Panel Lawyer for the State.
Mr. Anil Gulati, counsel for the respondent No.2.
Petitioners and respondent No.2 are present before this Court along with their respective counsels.

It is informed that upon complaint of respondent No.2, an FIR was registered against the petitioners on 10.07.2017 for the offence punishable under Sections 498A, 506B read with 34 of the IPC and Section 3, 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, and they have settled their dispute out of the Court.

Taking into consideration the fact that parties have settled their dispute, they are directed to appear before the Additional Registrar (Judicial)/Registrar (Judicial) for recording of their statement today itself.
Post the matter in the next week.

Sd/-
(Rakesh Mohan Pandey) Judge Nadim Naveen Kumar T vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/153276285/
